title: Babel Finance begins operating
description: Babel Finance developed as a Hong Kong-based crypto lender serving institutional and high-net-worth clients.

title: Babel Finance suspends redemptions and withdrawals
description: Babel Finance suspended redemptions and withdrawals across its products while citing unusual liquidity pressures during the 2022 crypto credit crisis.
notes: Core customer-impact event confirmed by contemporaneous reporting.

title: Babel begins debt negotiations
description: Babel Finance said it had reached preliminary agreements on repayment periods for some debts and continued discussions with counterparties after the withdrawal halt.
notes: Preliminary agreements did not restore normal withdrawals or complete restructuring.

title: Babel entities seek Singapore moratorium protection
description: Five entities affiliated with the Babel Finance group filed applications in the Singapore High Court for moratorium protection under section 64 of the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act 2018.
notes: The applications sought time to formulate a group restructuring through a scheme of arrangement.

title: Singapore High Court extends Babel moratoria
description: The Singapore High Court granted extensions of the moratoria sought by the Babel Finance group entities and permitted the restructuring process to continue in Singapore.
notes: Moratorium protection was procedural creditor protection, not completed restructuring or repayment.

title: Court permits Babel scheme meeting
description: The Singapore High Court granted Babel Holding Limited leave to convene a meeting of scheme creditors to consider a proposed scheme of arrangement.
notes: Leave to convene a scheme meeting did not itself establish scheme sanction or completed creditor distributions.

title: Nexo begins operating
description: Nexo developed as a crypto lending and interest-account platform offering borrowing and yield-like products.

title: Nexo settles U.S. Earn Interest Product charges
description: Nexo agreed to settle U.S. securities-regulator charges related to its Earn Interest Product and to cease offering the product to U.S. investors.
notes: Regulatory event, not a platform-failure event.

title: U.S. return through partner structure reported
description: Nexo was reported to be returning to the U.S. market through a partner structure after earlier regulatory restrictions.
notes: Jurisdictional availability should be monitored over time.

title: Ledn begins operating
description: Ledn developed as a bitcoin-backed lending and savings-oriented crypto platform.

title: Proof or reserve-style transparency maintained
description: Ledn continued to publish reserve or transparency-oriented materials as part of its active lender positioning.
notes: Use as active comparator evidence, not a failure event.

title: BlockFills begins operating
description: BlockFills developed as an institutional digital asset trading, liquidity, and financing platform.

title: BlockFills suspends client transfers and enters restructuring period
description: BlockFills suspended client deposits and withdrawals while reportedly keeping some trading functionality available. Subsequent reporting said the firm hired restructuring advisers amid loan losses, mining-related losses, and accounting problems.
notes: Ongoing case combining the verified client-transfer halt with later restructuring reporting; final legal and recovery outcome remains unresolved.
